messages:
anya (prod): Quick callout 9: we need a decision on 'regional slices' for Dedicated commits. Proposal: let a single reserved commit expose region-scoped slices (max 3) so customers can guarantee local latency without buying multiple full commits. Pros: less committed spend, better utilization. Cons: adds admission logic and per-slice telemetry. Thoughts?

joel (infra): Implementation would be a Slice record per commit with fields: region, tokens_reserved, window. Admission sums active tokens across slices. Prefill caches lazily. Limit slices per commit to 3 to bound metadata.

mike (eng-platform): Autoscale note: prefer shared prewarm across slices when on same region to avoid duplicated kernels. If slices cross regions then prewarm is per-region. Also we need spill-to-shared-pool behaviour defined.

ravi (sre): Ops ask: include an admin endpoint to merge slices into a single pool for emergency. Alert if slice-level preempt rate > 0.5% for 5m.

nina (pricing): Pricing question: do we discount idle hold for slice slots vs full commit? Suggest split-pricing: base commit price + small per-slice reservation fee. Will model impact.

anya (prod): Proposed defaults: max_slices=3, min_slice_tokens=50k, preempt_order=LIFO, spill_policy=shared_pool. Canary: 10 days internal with metric gates (latency, preempt rate, oncall pages). Launch: infra+ops+pricing signoff and 2 pilot customers.

sophia (sales): We have an EMEA customer interested if region affinity is guaranteed. I can lock pilot if timelines are 4-6 weeks.

joel (infra): Estimate MVP: infra + quota + console visibility = 3 sprints (6 weeks). Extra sprint for autoscale/perf tuning.

anya (prod): Decision poll: ship MVP with defaults above and canary plan? Reply +1 to approve.

mike (eng-platform): +1

joel (infra): +1

ravi (sre): +1

nina (pricing): +1 (will deliver cost model)

sophia (sales): +1 (will sign pilot)

capacity-bot: ACTIONS recorded: anya:update roadmap/spec; joel:infra PR+tests; mike:autoscale plan; nina:pricing model; ravi:ops runbook; sophia:pilot signoff. Target: 6 weeks.

anya (prod): Thanks all, closing thread unless objections. :white_check_mark:
